title: [Search for facet values] Refinement list - InstantSearch.js
body:
*This is a preview PR and I would love your input on the implementation, as well as the configuration options. The commits will be squashed to have a proper history.*

**Summary**

This PR provides an implementation of options to be able to search into facet values in the refinementList widget. When activated it adds a search input on top of the list, the results are replacing the values in the list. Pressing return when there are search results, selects the first item.

The API tries to stay consistent with the current implementation with a configuration object that  defaults and with the following structure (using the structure enables the feature):

* placeholder: string (plain text)
* templates: object
* templates.noResults: string (html  template)

**Result**
